assessment.nobel_worthiness: The firm-heterogeneity framework fundamentally reshaped modern trade theory and empirical work on selection, productivity, and gains from trade.
assessment.attribution: Melitz is central to the core framework, with Helpman and Redding making major complementary theoretical and empirical contributions.
assessment.maturity: The contribution has been deeply integrated into trade research and policy analysis over two decades.
uncertainties: The appropriate division of credit among the wider literature remains difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Structural methods for estimating demand, strategic competition, and industry dynamics transformed empirical industrial organization.
assessment.attribution: Pakes, Berry, and Bresnahan represent foundational and distinct pillars of the structural IO program.
assessment.maturity: The methods are established, widely used across markets, and have had durable influence on competition analysis.
uncertainties: The candidate grouping encompasses more contributors than can readily receive a joint prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamic-panel GMM made credible analysis of persistent panel processes feasible in a vast range of applied economic research.
assessment.attribution: Arellano, Bond, and Blundell have closely connected and clearly identifiable claims to the central estimators.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been scrutinized extensively and remain standard tools decades after their introduction.
uncertainties: Practical misuse of the estimators should be distinguished from the importance of the underlying contribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The economic analysis of information technology, network effects, and digital competition provided a durable framework for understanding modern markets.
assessment.attribution: Shapiro, Varian, and Farrell made foundational contributions to network-industry economics and its competition-policy implications.
assessment.maturity: The work has long influenced scholarship and has gained further salience as digital markets expanded.
uncertainties: The field's rapid evolution complicates separation of foundational contributions from later developments.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantitative Ricardian trade models provided an operational way to measure trade gains and connect theory to counterfactual policy analysis.
assessment.attribution: Costinot, Kortum, and Rodriguez-Clare are strongly associated with major advances in this coherent research program.
assessment.maturity: The approach has become central to quantitative trade and has been applied broadly.
uncertainties: Attribution overlaps with a broad preceding and subsequent quantitative-trade literature.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamic discrete-choice methods opened a powerful route for estimating forward-looking decisions in empirical economics.
assessment.attribution: Rust has a singular and unusually clear claim to the canonical foundational contribution.
assessment.maturity: The framework has generated a large, long-lived methodological and applied literature.
uncertainties: The broader dynamic-structural literature includes important later extensions by others.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Research on management practices established organizational quality as a measurable and economically important determinant of firm performance and productivity.
assessment.attribution: Bloom and Van Reenen pioneered the measurement program, with Sadun making major contributions to its development and application.
assessment.maturity: The findings have been replicated across countries and have shaped research on firms and productivity.
uncertainties: Causal interpretation and generalizability of measured management practices remain active research questions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Evolutionary economics and the concept of organizational routines offered an influential alternative account of firm behavior, innovation, and economic change.
assessment.attribution: Winter is an indispensable architect of the identified contribution.
assessment.maturity: Its conceptual influence has persisted across organizational economics, strategy, and innovation studies.
uncertainties: The contribution is less readily isolated as a single empirical discovery than some competing candidates.
